notes: The italicized second *cried* is given to the one written תְּיַבֵּב under rule 34's carve-out — the Hebrew writes the verb once across the two cola and the ASV realizes it twice — headed on the first occurrence, rather than marked `added`.
בֹּשֵׁשׁ is rendered *is … so long*, the copula and degree phrase belonging to that verb's unit and headed on the word carrying the lexeme (rules 20, 31).
The לְ before בוֹא takes the written *in* of the gerund recasting rather than going unrepresented (rule 52); the margin's literal gloss *steps* read and set aside (rule 38).
